glosses: taki, który nie wynika z praw natury
który nie wynika z czyjejś natury
Not occurring in nature, the environment or atmosphere

examples.text: Time wore heavily on with Winnie Santon, after Natalie had left them. Left as she was, much in her unnatural mother's society, who seemed to be never more pleased than when she might thwart her designs, or, in some manner act so as to make those about her uncomfortable, it was not to be wondered at, if she did sigh for other days, and a confidant, to whom she might unburden her heart.
One mother, when she heard that her daughter intended to take up medicine, retired to her room and wept, bewailing the fact that she had given birth to an "unnatural daughter."

glosses: One who is unnatural, against nature, perverse.

examples.text: In the so-called "golden era" of science fiction, gay/lesbian characters were treated as misfits, sociopaths, villains and "unnaturals" to be pitied and scorned. Gay characters were virtually all weak, effeminate snivelers out to harm the heroes of the story. Lesbians were invariably portrayed as massive, muscular Amazons with sadistic tendencies.
Deviants, heretics, pinks, false prophets and other unnaturals will not be spared the rod nor the stark fist of removal.

glosses: nicht natürlich, nicht der Natur entsprechend, nicht in der Art und Weise der Natur

examples.text: Die Straße war in ein unnatürliches Licht getaucht.
„Er liebt Rätsel, Wortspiele, Hieroglyphen und entwickelt bei ihrer Lösung oft einen Scharfsinn, der den mit dem Durchschnittsverstand begabten Menschenkindern unnatürlich erscheint.“
